title: Lineup Rollout Sequence
description: A festival lineup sequence that establishes one poster grammar and adapts it into square crops and social cutdowns without losing hierarchy.
creative_direction: The root image defines a lineup-poster system with stacked performer tiers, stage-energy atmosphere, and non-readable headliner blocks. The following images preserve the same artist-stack logic and color system while adapting for different social surfaces.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-reference-lineup-poster first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-square-artist-stack, 03-day-split-card, 04-night-headliner-card. Queue may run 02-square-artist-stack, 03-day-split-card, 04-night-headliner-card concurrently after 01-reference-lineup-poster is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
